author: Yahoo!
title: WV American Legion Motorcycle Club to visit Raleigh County - NewsBreak
text:
8 hours ago BECKLEY, WV (WVNS) — The West Virginia American Legion Motorcycle Club will be making a special stop in Beckley!. According to a press release, the West Virginia American Legion Motorcycle Club will visit the Raleigh County Veterans & First Responders Museum on May 28, 2026, beginning at 9:30 a.m. and ending at 10 a.m. This particular club has members from areas throughout the Mountain State and ride to raise funds for veterans to take part in Honor Flights, the release stated.
